_comment: Asset manifest for tools/blender/scene_kit.py. One entry per game-ready mesh.
Fields, all optional except source and out:
source      path to the authored art, relative to the repo root (.obj/.fbx/.glb)
out         where the game-ready .glb lands
textures    directory of downscaled maps to repoint images at before export
cull        list of face-deleting rules, applied first in source units (Blender Z up).
Each rule: below/above (z), x/y/z [lo,hi], outside/inside {center:[x,y],
radius}, name. All filters in a rule must match; first rule wins. For junk an
image-to-3D model copied from its reference: floor cables, a mat, loose props.
Read positions off views.png; see op_cull in scene_kit.py.
exaggerate  vertical multiplier applied in source proportions, before fit.
A terrain scan flatter than 0.2 relief-to-width needs this to read
as relief from a distance.
fit         {axis, size} uniform scale so that axis spans size studs
decimate    target triangle count before tiling
tile        [nx, ny] bisect grid; every tile must clear 10k triangles
pivot       center | bottom | top | origin
up          which Blender axis is up after import: x|y|z (default z). It is
normalised onto Blender Z before export, because export_yup maps
Blender Z to glTF Y and Roblox reads glTF as Y-up.
optimize    post-export meshoptimizer pass through tools/gltf_post.py, which
shells out to the glTF-Transform CLI and so needs npx on PATH.
{tris, texture, error, lockBorder, tint, lift, gamma}, all optional:
gamma      below 1 brightens the base colour before tint; for textures
the generator baked near-black (metal assumed). Keeps highlights.
tris       per-mesh triangle target; the run fails if the written
file still breaches the 10k cap afterwards
texture    clamp embedded textures to this many pixels (1024)
error      fix the simplifier error bound instead of escalating
lockBorder keep mesh borders; defaults to true when tile is set,
so neighbouring tiles stay watertight
Prefer this over `decimate` on a dense generated mesh -- it holds the
silhouette much better. It cannot collapse split vertices, so on
flat-shaded hard-surface art it stalls and says so; use decimate there.
Run: blender -b -noaudio --python tools/blender/scene_kit.py -- --asset <name>
